literature_motivation.claim: library-learning gains can vanish after compute matching and direct lemma reuse can be near-zero
literature_motivation.source: EACL 2026: Is This LLM Library Learning? Evaluation Must Account For Compute and Behaviour

literature_motivation.claim: TroVE compute-matched primitive baseline on MATH rose from 12% to 24% with equal sampling calls
literature_motivation.source: A Compute-Matched Re-Evaluation of TroVE on MATH

literature_motivation.claim: repeated sampling can Pareto-dominate more complex agent architectures under cost-controlled evaluation

A1_repeated_sampling_arm.definition: Bare solver, no accumulated products/library/enablement signal; spend the same top-level model-call budget as the paired library/complex arm through independent repeated attempts.
A1_repeated_sampling_arm.aggregation: Verifier-first best-of-k for formal outputs; self-consistency may break non-formal ranking ties but never substitutes for independent verification.
A1_repeated_sampling_arm.purpose: separate library/reaction value from extra stochastic sampling
A1_repeated_sampling_arm.primary_kill: If H1 does not beat H0_SAMPLE at the preregistered confirmatory threshold, no library-compounding claim is made.

A2_direct_reuse_instrumentation.reuse_claim_rule: A reusable-library claim requires the lower 95% confidence bound on mean distinct-problem final use among used products to exceed 1.0. Solve-rate gain without this is not called direct reuse.

mde.note: n=240 at two-sided alpha=0.025 gives approximately 80% power for d=0.20 under paired-t approximation; exact analysis follows the frozen outcome model.

cost_matching.primary_sampling_control: match top-level model-call count, model identity, per-call token cap, and verification policy problem-by-problem
cost_matching.exchange_rate_policy: No cross-resource substitution in the primary confirmatory claim; native resource caps/usage are reported component-wise. Any secondary scalarized complete-cost utility requires a rate table frozen before G8 reveal.

A3_preregistration.stopping_rule: No outcome-based early stopping or sample-size extension. Complete all preregistered arms for n=240 terminal problem pairs, or stop only for authority, contamination, verifier, transport, or hard resource-safety failure. Such a stop is not a scientific null.
A3_preregistration.pool_shortfall_rule: If the sealed G8 reservoir cannot support n=240 independent pairs before reveal, do not run confirmatory inference; resize/re-preregister before any outcome visibility.

A4_cost_accuracy_curves.decision_rule: No single budget point is sufficient for an efficiency claim. Report the full curve and Pareto relations; if H4 wins only at high budget, report that regime rather than collapsing to one number.

A5_H4_clean_ablation.H3: Same solver, products, retrieval, value model, action set, budget, cache/retention, verifier, stopping rule and event timing as H4, but enablement information is replaced by a schema/size/timing-matched preregistered placebo channel.
A5_H4_clean_ablation.H4: Identical to H3 with the true enablement signal substituted for the placebo channel.
A5_H4_clean_ablation.only_intended_difference: information content of the enablement signal
A5_H4_clean_ablation.coupling: Use paired problem assignment and frozen randomization/coupling wherever legal.
A5_H4_clean_ablation.claim_rule: Enablement control value is established only if the preregistered lower confidence bound for H4-H3 is >0 at alpha=0.025 after matched budget accounting. Higher variance is reported, never hand-waved or repaired post hoc.

arm_constraints.H1: Existing verified-product/library arm unchanged except reuse logging.
arm_constraints.H3: Existing no-enablement control, constrained to be mechanically identical to H4 except placebo enablement information.
arm_constraints.H4: Existing enablement/reaction-aware arm, mechanically identical to H3 except true enablement information.

confirmatory_interpretation.H1_not_gt_H0_SAMPLE: Known repeated-sampling explanation survives; no library-compounding claim.
confirmatory_interpretation.H1_gt_H0_SAMPLE_but_reuse_not_establishe: Performance gain exists but is not attributed to direct reusable-library behavior.
confirmatory_interpretation.H4_not_gt_H3: Enablement/reaction signal has no established incremental control value under this regime; graph may remain diagnostic/provenance infrastructure.
confirmatory_interpretation.H4_gt_H3: Reaction/enablement information has prospective incremental control value beyond identical products, retrieval and value model.
